title: Page 3
content_zh:
如果不想跟他出去，现在是拒绝的最后机会。乔若曦深吸一口气——
“呃，我……”
“山上冷，最好带着外套。”他皱眉，不赞同的看着她薄薄的针织衫。
“啊？噢，好。”他一敛眉，严肃的脸孔就更加严峻，她下意识的听话，乖乖拿起衣架上的粉红色外套。
拿起外套她才想到不对，她要跟他说她不跟他约什么会了，从头到尾是一场误会。
“我——”
“走吧！有什么事车上讲。”
他像熊一般的手掌箝制住她细瘦的肩膀，她吓了一跳，就在发怔的瞬间，她已经失去解释的机会，被他拉着往店外走去。
车子沿着黑暗的山路一路蜿蜒往上，黑漆漆的深夜里，只有他们这辆车，彷佛行驶在无人的世界里。
鸡皮疙瘩爬上乔若曦的手臂，她打了个寒颤，不只担心坐在旁边的高大男人，还害怕暗夜中的山沟里，那些暗影不知道是什么。
对啦！她就是怕黑也怕鬼，更怕坏人。
“冷吗？穿外套。”旁边传来的声音让她一震，她不知道他怎么会注意到她的动作的，他在开车不是吗？他的外表虽然粗犷，可是似乎比她想象中还来得敏锐。
“是。”
听到他的命令句，她急忙穿上外套，这似乎已经变成一种惯性。
他没再说什么，关上了他刚刚说想透透气而
车子又往前开了几分钟，乔若曦偷偷看他一眼，发现他的额头上布了一层薄薄的汗，她吓了一跳。
“啊！你可以不用开暖气没关系，车窗也可以
“没关系。”
“可是你都流汗了。”
“我无所谓。”他绷着脸，一副不用继续这个话题的样子。

她张大嘴，有些不敢相信，其实……他似乎人还满好的。
茫然的想着，没注意外面的景色，直到他说到了，她才回过神来。
乔若曦慌慌张张的，眼看身体就要难看的趴在地上，她闭上眼睛哀叫一声。
没想到预期中的疼痛没有发生，她落在一个温暖厚实的怀抱里。
“小心。”
浑厚低沉的嗓音透过胸膛传来些微的震动，乔若曦一愣，脸迅速红了，但她把那种心跳加速的感觉归为是差点跌倒的反应。
“谢谢。”
“你似乎很迷糊。”刚刚看她差点跌倒受伤，他的心好像要跳出喉咙一般。他是很习惯受伤的人，可是不知怎么的，一想到她受伤的样子，他就有种很心痛的感觉。
被说迷糊的乔若曦更尴尬了，她承认她是常常会恍神啦，不过这回也不能全怪她。
“车子太高了，我不习惯才会这样。”她替自己辩解。
“以后你得学着习惯。”他很专制的说出这句话，然后又加了一句，“算了，以后下车等我帮你开门。”
被这两个字吓得不轻，他是说他们还有很多“以后”吗？想到这里，绝望的感觉顿时淹没了她。
已经全身僵化的乔若曦，连他什么时候放开她都没有感觉。
“牵好。”他像对小孩那样的嘱咐她，然后不由分说的紧紧握住她的手，往餐厅的方向走。
餐厅是纯日式的建筑，黑色原木搭建而成，高雅而安静。
“欢迎光临。”穿着和服的老板娘在门口迎接他们。
褚天阔看到她微微点了点头。“都安排好了吧？”
“是的，都依照您的要求。请跟我来。”
乔若曦愣愣的看着他们对话，陌生的环境、陌生的人，他们交换的会意眼神让她惊惶。
安排好了？是安排什么呢？她感觉自己是那个唯一被蒙在鼓里的人。

不过手被牵着，她哪里也不能去，只能跟着他们来到一间单独的包厢。
包厢一样相当雅致，宽敞的榻榻米上只摆放了一张原木桌子跟两个椅垫，乔若曦松了口气，看来是要在这里吃饭。
其实凭良心讲，这个餐厅若不是偏远了点，装潢气氛倒是很有味道，只是她跟褚天阔在一起，无论如何就是没办法放松下来。
“好了，把衣服脱了。”
“噢，是——啥？”
她大张着嘴的模样一定很呆，因为她听到老板娘掩嘴轻笑的声音。
可是她一点都不觉得好笑。没想到……没想到这个男人竟然如此直接，而、而且还当着别人的面……太过分了吧！
“褚老板你这样不行，把人家小姑娘吓到了。”处世圆融的老板娘出来缓颊。“这位小姐，褚老板的意思是你们用餐前先泡泡温泉，你瞧，我们这里有上好的温泉。”
她巧妙的对着山下的夜景，又不至于有被人偷窥的危险，池子里冒着暖暖的热气，看了就让人想要沉浸在那干净的池水里，放松一下紧绷的神经。
“露天的温泉是我们的特色喔！”老板娘继续介绍。“这边有帮您准备好的盥洗用具，您还可以使用这边的浴衣。”
“我、我不要！”紧抓着上衣，乔若曦脸色苍白。
褚天阔看着她，没说什么，只是绷着脸，让人看不清他的情绪。
“我去隔壁。”最后他丢下这句话就转身走开了。
他的离开让乔若曦松了一口气，只要他在，她就觉得压力好大，根本放松不下来，不过她还有点不敢置信自己竟然就这样轻易逃过一劫。
还在发愣的时候，老板娘笑了。“褚老板本来就跟我们说他打算去男汤泡汤，把房间留给您，让我们准备的也只有您的盥洗用具。”
听老板娘这么说，她才发现房间里确实只有一套用具跟一件浴衣。
“不过他把您吓了一跳吧？”
乔若曦整张脸顿时火烫起来，不好意思的点点头。
“褚老板是我们的常客，认识很久了，他一向沉默寡言，不太会表达自己，不过是个很体贴的好男人。你们交往不久吧？”
“呃……”说来话长，乔若曦尴尬的慌了手脚。

“您慢慢就会了解他了。”
她一点也不想了解他，只想赶快把误会解释清楚，从此不要再见到这个可怕的男人。
不过她还来不及说什么，老板娘就带着满脸的笑意准备离开。“请好好享受一下我们的温泉，晚餐一个小时以后会准备好。”
“谢、谢谢。”她只能这么说，然后呆呆的看着老板娘转身离去。
现在只剩下她，还有屋外诱人的温泉……
她看着那袅袅升起的热气，虽然知道自己这种容易屈服于欲望又随波逐流的个性实在非常不可取，可是偷看了一眼关紧的门后，她还是缓缓的解开外套的扣子。
温泉水就跟她想象的一样舒服，刚开始她还不时望着门口，害怕褚天阔会突然闯进来，可是过了几分钟，她发现自己的防备是多余，于是开始专心沉醉在温泉里。
“啊——”全身的肌肉好像都得到了舒缓，暖乎乎的让人忍不住叹息。
多久没有这么享受了？她这几年一直都被绑在店里，因为没有钱请人帮忙，所以只得一个人把所有的事情都揽在肩上，一早就要开始准备食材，等店关门收拾完也都十点了。
以前店里还有爸妈在，可是几年前他们两个因为帮人作保，欠了上千万，冷酷无情的银行把债权移转给私人讨债公司，他们在店门口喷漆、不断打电话骚扰，用各种手法让他们一家人陷入痛苦深渊，甚至还暗示他们可以到黑市去卖器官，把爸妈吓到躲起来。
content_en:
If you don't want to go out with him, now is your last chance to say no. Qiao Ruoxi took a deep breath——
"Uh, I..."
"It's cold in the mountains, so you'd better bring a coat." He frowned and looked at her thin sweater with disapproval.
"Ah? Oh, okay." He frowned and his serious face became more serious. She subconsciously obeyed and picked up the pink coat on the hanger.
When she picked up her coat, she realized something was wrong. She wanted to tell him that she didn't want to date him anymore. It was a misunderstanding from beginning to end.
"I——"
"Let's go! Let's talk about anything in the car."
His bear-like palm clamped down on her slender shoulders, and she was startled. In the moment of daze, she had lost the chance to explain, and was pulled by him out of the store.
The car wound its way up the dark mountain road. In the dark night, they were the only car, as if they were driving in a deserted world.
Goosebumps crawled up Qiao Ruoxi's arms, and she shuddered. Not only was she worried about the tall man sitting next to her, she was also afraid of what those shadows in the ravine in the dark night were.
That’s right! She is afraid of the dark, ghosts, and even bad people.
"Is it cold? Put on a coat." The voice from beside her shocked her. She didn't know how he noticed her movements. He was driving, wasn't he? Although his appearance was rough, he seemed to be sharper than she imagined.
"Yes."
After hearing his command, she hurriedly put on her coat, which seemed to have become a habit.
He didn't say anything else and closed the door. He just said he wanted to get some air.
The car drove forward for a few more minutes. Qiao Ruoxi glanced at him secretly and was shocked to find a thin layer of sweat on his forehead.
"Ah! It doesn't matter if you don't need to turn on the heater. The car windows can also be used.
"It doesn't matter. "
“But you’re sweating. "
"I don't care. "He had a sullen face, as if he didn't need to continue this topic.
She opened her mouth wide and couldn't believe it. In fact... he seemed to be quite a nice person.
She was thinking blankly and didn't pay attention to the scenery outside. It wasn't until he said it that she came back to her senses.
Qiao Ruoxi was in a panic. Seeing that her body was about to fall ugly to the ground, she closed her eyes and screamed.
Unexpectedly, the expected pain did not occur, and she fell into a warm and thick embrace.
"Be careful. "
The deep and deep voice sent a slight vibration through her chest. Qiao Ruoxi was stunned and her face quickly turned red, but she attributed the feeling of accelerated heartbeat to the reaction of almost falling.
"Thank you. "
“You seem confused. "Just now he saw that she almost fell and got injured, and his heart seemed to jump out of his throat. He was very used to being injured, but for some reason, when he thought of her being injured, he felt very heartbroken.
Qiao Ruoxi, who was said to be confused, was even more embarrassed. She admitted that she often lost her mind, but this time she couldn't blame her entirely.
“The car is too high, I’m not used to it. ” she defended herself.
“You have to learn to get used to it in the future. He said this very authoritatively, and then added, "Forget it, get off the car and wait for me to open the door for you." "
He was frightened by these two words. Did he mean that they still have many "futures"? Thinking of this, a feeling of despair suddenly overwhelmed her.
Qiao Ruoxi, whose whole body was frozen, didn't even feel when he let her go.
"Hold it well. "He told her like he would a child, then held her hand tightly without any explanation and walked towards the restaurant.
The restaurant is a purely Japanese-style building, made of black logs, elegant and quiet.
"Welcome. "The landlady in kimono greeted them at the door.
Chu Tiankuo saw her nodding slightly. "Is everything arranged? "
"Yes, as per your request. plz follow me. "
Qiao Ruoxi stared blankly at their conversation. The strange environment, strange people, and the knowing glances they exchanged frightened her.
Already arranged? YesWhat are the arrangements? She felt like she was the only one left in the dark.
But with her hand being held, she couldn't go anywhere and could only follow them to a separate box.
The private room was also quite elegant. There was only a log table and two chair cushions placed on the spacious tatami. Qiao Ruoxi breathed a sigh of relief. It seemed that she wanted to eat here.
In fact, to be honest, if this restaurant wasn't a little remote, the decoration and atmosphere would be very interesting, but she and Chu Tiankuo were together, so she couldn't relax no matter what.
"Okay, take off your clothes."
"Oh, it's - what?"
She must have looked dumb with her mouth wide open, because she heard the landlady cover her mouth and chuckle.
But she didn't find it funny at all. I didn't expect...I didn't expect that this man would be so direct, and, and in front of others...it was too much!
"Boss Chu, you can't do this, you're scaring the little girl." The smooth-mannered landlady came out to soften her cheeks. "Miss, what Boss Chu wants is for you to soak in the hot springs before dining. You see, we have good hot springs here."
She cleverly faced the night view at the bottom of the mountain without being in danger of being peeped. The pool was filled with warm steam. Just looking at it made people want to immerse themselves in the clean water and relax their tense nerves.
"The open-air hot spring is our specialty!" the proprietress continued. "There are toiletries prepared for you here, and you can also use the yukata here."
"I, I don't want it!" Qiao Ruoxi's face turned pale as she clutched her shirt tightly.
Chu Tiankuo looked at her and said nothing, but his face was sullen, making it difficult for people to see his emotions clearly.
"I'll go next door." Finally, he turned around and walked away.
His departure made Qiao Ruoxi breathe a sigh of relief. As long as he was around, she felt so stressed that she couldn't relax at all, but she still couldn't believe that she escaped so easily.
While still in a daze, the landlady smiled. "Boss Chu originally told us that he planned to go to the men's bath and leave the room to you. The only thing we asked us to prepare was your toiletries."
After hearing what the landlady said, she realized that there was indeed only one set of utensils and a bathrobe in the room.
"But he scared you, didn't he?"
Qiao Ruoxi's whole face suddenly became hot and she nodded sheepishly.
"Boss Chu is our regular customer. We have known him for a long time. He has always been taciturn and is not very good at expressing himself. However, he is a very considerate and good man. Have you been dating for a long time?"
"Uh..." It was a long story, and Qiao Ruoxi panicked in embarrassment.
"You get to know him over time."
She didn't want to understand him at all, she just wanted to explain the misunderstanding quickly and never see this terrible man again.
But before she could say anything, the landlady was about to leave with a smile on her face. "Please enjoy our hot springs. Dinner will be ready in an hour."
"Thank you, thank you." She could only say this, and then stared blankly at the landlady as she turned and left.
Now only she is left, and the tempting hot spring outside the house...
She looked at the rising heat. Although she knew that her personality of easily succumbing to desires and going with the flow was really undesirable, she still took a peek at the closed door and slowly unbuttoned her coat.
The hot spring water was as comfortable as she imagined. At first, she looked at the door from time to time, fearing that Chu Tiankuo would suddenly barge in, but after a few minutes, she realized that her defenses were unnecessary, so she began to concentrate on indulging in the hot spring.
"Ah——" All the muscles in the body seemed to be soothed, and it was so warm that one couldn't help but sigh.
How long has it been since you enjoyed this? She has been tied up in the store for the past few years. Because she has no money to hire help, she has to shoulder everything on her own shoulders. She has to start preparing ingredients early in the morning and finish cleaning up after the store closes.It's ten o'clock.
There used to be parents in the store, but a few years ago, the two of them owed tens of millions because they were guarantees for others. The ruthless bank transferred the debt to a private debt collection company. They spray-painted the door of the store, made constant phone calls and harassed them, and used various methods to plunge the family into an abyss of pain. They even suggested that they could sell their organs on the black market, scaring the parents into hiding.
